title: Artwork Guesser Multiplayer, other fixes and improvements

texts: Added multiplayer support for Artwork Guesser. Compete with others to get the highest score.
Rewrote the randomizers for both Guessers. This should hopefully make the randomization more uniform.
Changed the names of the modifiers on both Guessers to make them clearer.
Fixed a bug that caused the Global Chat's history to be cleared when it's empty for a certain period of time.
Fixed an issue where the deployment order on MD Plans wouldn't update properly when using the Spec Build Recommendation Mode
Fixed a crash when sorting with Advanced Compare Mode using certain properties on the E.G.Os page.
Fixed Identity and E.G.O Rank filters in the Community Rankings page being applied even when changing to tabs where they aren't relevant.
Reduced the horizontal padding on the homepage for mobile.
